messages.content: Wednesday is confirmed for 7:30 a.m. at the Dublin restaurant. Use the Hyatt there and switch the ground plan to a rental car. Before you book, check the full timing and make sure the totals include taxes and hotel parking.

The schedule works. Tuesday’s American nonstop leaves O’Hare at 8:05 a.m. and reaches Columbus at 10:24 a.m. A 10:45 a.m. rental pickup gives you about 35 minutes to drive to Easton, leaving roughly two hours before the 2:00 p.m. operating review. After the 4:00 p.m. finish, the Hyatt Place Columbus/Dublin is about 25-35 minutes away. Wednesday, the restaurant is under 10 minutes from the hotel, so leaving at 7:10 a.m. is sufficient. The all-in estimate is $612: $318 airfare, $168 hotel including tax, and $126 rental including taxes and airport fees. Self-parking at the Hyatt is complimentary.
What time should I leave the restaurant for the airport, and is there enough room if the visit runs long?

For the 6:45 p.m. return, leave the Dublin area by 4:30 p.m. That allows 30-40 minutes to CMH, fuel nearby, rental return by 5:20 p.m., and about 75 minutes for security and the gate. Even if the restaurant visit runs to 10:00 a.m., you retain more than six hours before departure.
Confirm the hotel cancellation cutoff and the exact rental window.

The Hyatt is cancelable without penalty until 6:00 p.m. Monday, October 28. The rental is Tuesday, October 29 at 10:45 a.m. through Wednesday, October 30 at 5:20 p.m. Returning after 5:20 p.m. could trigger an additional charge, so the 4:30 p.m. departure from Dublin should remain the latest target.
That all works. Complete the flight, hotel, and rental.

Leave the hotel around 7:10 a.m. Wednesday and the restaurant area no later than 4:30 p.m.
